ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 85% low-intensity black pixels to 15% high-intensity white pixels (scars and barnacles).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal tips exhibit high-intensity contiguous clusters; medial and lateral regions display a dense network of high-contrast linear and punctate white markers on a black background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; vertical depth occupies approximately 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary; left lobe trailing edge displays moderate serration; right lobe trailing edge contains two significant macro-depressions creating a stepped profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves on the proximal trailing edges, transitioning to steep upward-sweeping concave arcs toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white nodes on the distal-most tips (left and right); scattered individual circular white scars across the central lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of crisscrossing white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the entirety of both ventral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on outer tips; pervasive rake marks; irregular traumatic loss of tissue on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged indentation on the right lobe trailing edge, approximately 40% distance from the notch to the tip.
